label: India
summary: Indian English business conventions and ₹ (INR) currency formatting
Clear recognition of lakh and crore numbering conventions
Standardized phrasing replacing redundant regional bureaucratic idioms
tone_principles: Courteous, professional, and clear for Indian audiences.
writing_style: Indian English spelling (e.g., colour, organise) with clear currency symbols (₹ / INR).
messaging_principles: Ensure statutory GST, tax disclosures, and regional delivery schedules are explicitly specified.

rules.title: Indian English Professional Phrasing
rules.description: Replace archaic bureaucratic idioms with modern, direct international business expressions.

suggested_replacements.out of station: traveling or out of the office

rules.do_example: Please reply with your confirmation once the review is complete.
rules.dont_example: Kindly do the needful and revert back at the earliest.

terminology.notes: Replace archaic bureaucratic phrasing with direct, actionable language.
